products.name: Sports Recruitment Platform (Signing Day Sports)
products.description: A digital platform (mobile app and web portal) that connects high school student-athletes with college coaches and recruiters for sports recruitment. The platform enables athletes to upload video-verified athletic and academic data, game film, and skill drills, and allows coaches to search, evaluate, and communicate with prospects. Delivered as a subscription-based SaaS product, it is available for football, baseball, softball, and men’s and women’s soccer, with plans to expand to additional sports.

products.name: Sports Combine and Event Management Services
products.description: Operation and management of in-person sports combines, camps, tournaments, and showcase events (e.g., U.S. Army Bowl National Combine, regional combines, football skills camps, soccer tournaments) where athletes are evaluated and provided with video-verified data for recruitment. These events generate revenue through entry fees and provide trial access to the digital platform.

products.name: Educational Content and Recruiting Guidance
products.description: Provision of educational resources, webinars, blog content (The Wire), and video tutorials (SDS University) to student-athletes, parents, and coaches about the recruiting process, platform usage, and related topics. Delivered digitally via the app, website, and social media, this service supports users throughout their recruitment journey.

products.name: Branded Apparel and Nutrition Products
products.description: Sales of branded apparel, supplements, and nutrition products related to the Signing Day Sports brand, often in connection with events or through co-branded consumer product arrangements. These are physical products sold to athletes and their families.

products.name: Project Consulting Services
products.description: Professional consulting services focused on project execution across functional areas such as accounting, finance, technology, risk, compliance, and supply chain. Delivered by experienced consultants, these services are provided on a project basis and require in-person and remote human expertise.

products.name: On-Demand Talent Services
products.description: Provision of agile, highly skilled professionals to fill resource gaps for clients on a flexible, as-needed basis. Services are delivered by mobilizing talent quickly to support client initiatives, requiring human labor and talent management infrastructure.

products.name: Outsourced Finance, Accounting, and HR Services
products.description: Outsourced services for finance, accounting, and human resources functions, primarily for startups and scale-ups, delivered via a technology platform and fractional teams. Involves both digital infrastructure and human expertise.

products.name: Crisis Communication and Public Relations Services
products.description: Corporate, financial, transactional, and crisis communication and management services provided through a specialized firm. Delivered by experienced professionals, often requiring rapid response and strategic advisory.

products.name: Technology and Digital Transformation Consulting
products.description: Consulting services focused on digital transformation, technology modernization, cloud migration, data analytics, and automation. Delivered by subject matter experts and may involve both advisory and implementation work, leveraging digital tools and platforms.

products.name: Customer Engagement Platform
products.description: A cloud-based, enterprise-grade software platform that enables brands to orchestrate, personalize, and deliver cross-channel customer engagement campaigns using first-party data, AI, and real-time analytics. Delivered as a SaaS subscription, it integrates with customer apps, websites, and digital interfaces to manage messaging, segmentation, and campaign execution across multiple channels.

products.name: Cross-Channel Messaging Solutions
products.description: A suite of messaging capabilities supporting email, push notifications (mobile and web), SMS/MMS/RCS, WhatsApp, LINE, in-app/in-browser messages, content cards, banners, landing pages, and webhooks. These are delivered via the platform and enable brands to reach customers across digital and in-product channels, with real-time orchestration and personalization.

products.name: AI-Powered Personalization and Decisioning Tools
products.description: A set of AI and machine learning features embedded throughout the platform, including BrazeAI Decisioning Studio, Agent Console, Operator, predictive analytics, and content generation tools. These tools automate and optimize message targeting, content, timing, and channel selection to maximize engagement and business outcomes.

products.name: Data Integration and Streaming Services
products.description: Capabilities for ingesting, syncing, transforming, and exporting first-party customer data in real time via SDKs, APIs, partner integrations, and cloud data ingestion. Enables seamless integration with customer data warehouses, analytics platforms, and other marketing technologies, supporting real-time segmentation and campaign triggers.

products.name: Journey Orchestration and Campaign Management Tools
products.description: Tools such as Canvas (no-code journey builder), Campaigns, and event/API triggering that allow marketers to design, test, and optimize multi-step, cross-channel customer journeys and campaigns. These tools support real-time execution, experimentation, and optimization of engagement strategies.

products.name: Reporting and Analytics Solutions
products.description: A suite of analytics and reporting features, including campaign analytics, funnel and retention reports, dashboards, and AI-powered query builders. These tools provide insights into engagement performance, conversion, and customer behavior to inform and optimize marketing strategies.

products.name: Content Management and Creative Tools
products.description: Features for managing, generating, and personalizing marketing content, including AI copywriting, image generation, content QA, templates, content blocks, catalogs, and Liquid templating. These tools help marketers efficiently create and deploy personalized, on-brand content across channels.

products.name: Ad Network and Audience Sync Integrations
products.description: Integration capabilities that allow brands to sync first-party data with major ad networks (Meta, Google, TikTok, etc.) for targeted advertising and unified owned/paid channel strategies, leveraging behavioral triggers and segmentation from the Braze platform.

products.name: Transactional Messaging Services
products.description: A premium, high-reliability messaging service for critical transactional use cases, offering enhanced speed and delivery guarantees for time-sensitive communications.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides loans to businesses and government municipalities for purposes such as operations, property, plant and equipment, and working capital. These loans are generally secured by business assets and personal guarantees and require in-person human labor and financial capital for underwriting and servicing.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers loans secured by commercial properties such as hotels, office buildings, apartment buildings, retail sites, and farmland. These loans are highly dependent on business operations for repayment and require regulated financial capital and underwriting expertise.

products.name: Construction and Land Development Lending
products.description: Provides loans to finance the purchase of land and the construction of residential and commercial buildings, secured by mortgages on real estate. This involves regulated financial capital and risk management during construction phases.

products.name: Residential Mortgage and Home Equity Lending
products.description: Offers traditional residential mortgages and home equity products to consumers, secured by residential real estate. These products require regulated underwriting, financial capital, and compliance with consumer protection laws.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides unsecured personal lines of credit and installment loans, some of which are secured by rapidly depreciating assets like automobiles. Delivery requires financial capital and in-person or digital servicing.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Accepts and maintains checking, savings, money management accounts, and time deposits (certificates of deposit/CDs) for retail, commercial, and municipal customers. Requires regulated infrastructure and in-person or digital account management.

products.name: Wealth Management and Trust Services
products.description: Provides personal and corporate trust services, estate planning and administration, pension and employee benefit fund management, custodial services, and non-trust investment services. Delivered through specialized human labor and regulated fiduciary infrastructure.

products.name: Investment Product Sales
products.description: Sells mutual funds, annuities, and selected insurance products through licensed members of the Wealth Management department. Delivery is via licensed financial professionals and digital or in-person channels.

products.name: Theatrical Exhibition Services
products.description: Operation of movie theaters that exhibit mainstream, alternative, and local films, as well as special events, across the U.S. and Latin America. This involves physical venues with advanced projection and sound technology, premium seating, and various auditorium formats.

products.name: Food and Beverage Sales
products.description: Sale of concession products including popcorn, soft drinks, candy, quick-serve foods, and enhanced food and beverage options such as beer, wine, cocktails, and chef-inspired dishes, delivered in-theater, via mobile ordering, and through third-party delivery platforms.

products.name: Screen Advertising Services
products.description: Provision of on-screen and lobby advertising to national, regional, and local advertisers through digital pre-show programs and in-theater displays, managed via partnerships in the U.S. and proprietary brands internationally.

products.name: Merchandise Sales
products.description: Sale of movie-themed merchandise both in theaters and online, including unique and classic items related to current and past films, available for purchase by guests nationwide.

products.name: Membership and Loyalty Programs
products.description: Subscription-based and points-based programs offering benefits such as discounted tickets, concessions, and exclusive offers, managed digitally and available in both domestic and international markets.

products.name: Private Events and Facility Rentals
products.description: Rental of theater facilities for private events, including hosting of parties, corporate gatherings, and special screenings, leveraging physical theater infrastructure and amenities.

products.name: Alternative Entertainment Content
products.description: Exhibition of non-mainstream content such as concerts, live-streamed events, documentaries, and performing arts, often via partnerships and satellite technology, in addition to regular film programming.

products.name: In-Theater Entertainment Experiences
products.description: Provision of additional entertainment options such as game rooms, bowling, laser tag, arcade games, and restaurant/bar spaces within select theater locations, requiring physical infrastructure and in-person service.

products.name: Lending Services
products.description: The company provides various lending services to businesses, nonprofits, and municipalities, including new loans, expanded loans, and specialized facilities. These services require significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Liquidity and Credit Facilities
products.description: The company offers liquidity and credit facilities such as corporate credit facilities, asset-backed securities loan facilities, and money market mutual fund liquidity facilities, which are structured financial products requiring regulatory oversight and financial capital.

products.name: Overnight Reserve Lending and Repurchase Agreements
products.description: The company provides overnight reserve lending and reverse repurchase agreements to depository institutions, facilitating short-term liquidity in the banking system. These services are delivered through regulated financial infrastructure.

products.name: Dark Tea Products
products.description: Production, processing, and sale of dark tea, primarily in the form of compressed brick tea (Qingzhuan tea), mini brick dark tea, and loose-leaf dark tea. Products are manufactured through physical processing, fermentation, and compression at company-owned facilities, and distributed via direct sales and third-party channels.

products.name: Green and Black Tea Products
products.description: Manufacture and sale of green tea and black tea, produced through traditional tea processing lines at company facilities. Products are processed, packaged, and distributed to wholesale and retail customers.

products.name: Methanol Fuel Additives
products.description: Research, manufacture, and distribution of methanol fuel additives designed to enhance combustion performance, stability, and safety of methanol-based fuels. Production occurs at dedicated chemical facilities with labeling and packaging capabilities.

products.name: Alcohol-Based Fuel
products.description: Manufacture and sale of alcohol-based fuel, primarily used in catering stoves, industrial boilers, and heating equipment as a clean alternative energy source. Produced at company chemical facilities and distributed to commercial and industrial customers.

products.name: Diesel Fuel
products.description: Manufacture and distribution of diesel fuel for use in diesel-powered vehicles, construction machinery, and industrial operations. Production is conducted at company facilities and products are sold to transportation and industrial customers.

products.name: Digital Advertising Services
products.description: Provision of digital advertising delivery and operational services, including advertising placement, campaign execution, account management, and performance optimization across digital channels in China and North America. Services are delivered via a combination of internal technical resources and external partnerships.

products.name: Restaurant Point-of-Sale (POS) and Operations Platform
products.description: A cloud-based, all-in-one POS and restaurant operations platform that integrates order taking, payment processing, kitchen display systems, menu management, and multi-location management, delivered via proprietary software and restaurant-grade hardware.

products.name: Integrated Payment Processing Solutions
products.description: Fully integrated payment processing services that enable secure acceptance of in-store and online payments, including card readers, contactless payments, and consolidated reporting, delivered through proprietary hardware and software.

products.name: Online Ordering and Delivery Solutions
products.description: Software solutions for restaurants to manage digital ordering and delivery, including branded websites, apps, commission-free first-party ordering, and integrations with third-party channels, all connected to the POS system.

products.name: Marketing and Loyalty Solutions
products.description: Integrated marketing tools for restaurants to deliver targeted email and SMS campaigns, manage advertising, build loyalty programs, offer gift cards, and take reservations, leveraging guest data and AI-powered features.

products.name: Team and Payroll Management Solutions
products.description: Centralized software for employee onboarding, scheduling, payroll processing, and team communication, integrated with POS data to streamline workforce management for restaurants and food and beverage retailers.

products.name: Vendor and Inventory Management Solutions
products.description: Back-office software tools for accounts payable automation, inventory management, ingredient price tracking, and recipe costing, integrating POS, payroll, accounting, and supplier data to optimize restaurant margins.

products.name: Food and Beverage Retail Solutions
products.description: A mobile-first POS and inventory management platform tailored for food and beverage retailers (e.g., convenience stores, bottle shops, grocery stores), featuring barcode scanning, smart inventory planning, and unified reporting.

products.name: Financial Technology and Lending Solutions
products.description: Financial technology services including commercial loans (Toast Capital), automated credit card surcharging, commercial leasing (Easy Pay), and payroll card solutions, leveraging proprietary data and integrated with the Toast platform.

products.name: Restaurant-Grade Hardware
products.description: Custom-designed, durable hardware including POS terminals, handheld devices, self-service kiosks, kitchen display systems, and contactless payment readers, pre-configured for self-installation and integrated with Toast software.

products.name: Artificial Intelligence and Analytics Solutions (Toast IQ)
products.description: Conversational AI assistant and analytics tools embedded in the Toast platform, providing real-time and historical data insights, trend identification, and workflow automation for restaurant operators.

products.name: SD-WAN Software Platform
products.description: A software-defined wide area network (SD-WAN) platform that integrates network traffic management, routing, security, and monitoring functions. Delivered as a subscription, it can be deployed on dedicated appliances or virtually in cloud, hybrid, or on-premise environments. Requires software development, network engineering, and can be installed on customer hardware or as a virtual solution.

products.name: SASE Software Solution
products.description: A Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) software solution that integrates WAN-edge appliances with cloud-delivered security and networking services. Delivered as a subscription, it combines firewall, encryption, web filtering, and other security features for hybrid workforce and branch locations. Requires software development and integration with customer or third-party hardware.

products.name: Network Monitoring Service (NMS)
products.description: A network monitoring and management software platform (EnterpriseView Reporting System) that provides real-time insights, device health monitoring, and performance analytics for customer networks and FatPipe devices. Delivered as a scalable software solution, it supports large data loads and remote management. Requires software development and network engineering.

products.name: Technical Support and Installation Services
products.description: Subscription-based technical support services including remote and on-site support, installation, configuration assistance, monitoring, alerts, and performance reporting for FatPipe software solutions. Delivered by in-house specialists, requiring human labor and technical expertise.

products.name: Professional and Consulting Services
products.description: Professional and consulting services for network implementation design, network analysis, capacity planning, and custom WAN/LAN solution development. Includes IT consulting, application development, ERP integrations, and outsourced staffing for enterprises, delivered by FatPipe Technologies division. Requires specialized human labor and technical expertise.

products.name: Cruise Vacations
products.description: Carnival Corporation & plc operates a portfolio of cruise lines offering contemporary, premium, and luxury cruise vacations globally. These are delivered via physical cruise ships, providing accommodations, meals, entertainment, and visits to multiple destinations, with experiences tailored by brand and market segment.

products.name: Onboard Goods and Services
products.description: A range of goods and services sold to cruise guests during their voyage, including beverage sales, internet and communication services, casino gaming, spa services, specialty restaurants, retail, and photo sales. These are delivered through onboard facilities and sometimes via independent concessionaires.

products.name: Shore Excursions and Experiences
products.description: Organized tours and activities at ports of call, offered as optional add-ons to cruise vacations. These are delivered through partnerships with local providers or directly by the company, and may be purchased in advance or onboard.

products.name: Port Destinations and Exclusive Islands
products.description: Ownership and operation of private port destinations and exclusive islands, providing unique shore experiences and amenities for cruise guests. These are physical destinations developed and managed by the company to enhance the cruise product.

products.name: Alaska Land Tours and Transportation
products.description: Land-based tour packages in Alaska and the Canadian Yukon, including hotel stays, lodges, railcars, and motorcoach transportation, primarily operated by Holland America Princess Alaska Tours. These are delivered through owned and operated physical infrastructure and complement Alaska cruise operations.

products.name: Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy Therapeutics
products.description: A portfolio of RNA-targeted exon-skipping therapies (EXONDYS 51, VYONDYS 53, AMONDYS 45) and gene therapy (ELEVIDYS) for the treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy, produced using proprietary PMO chemistry and AAV-based gene therapy, delivered via infusion and distributed through specialty pharmacies and hospitals.

products.name: Limb-Girdle Muscular Dystrophy (LGMD) Gene Therapy
products.description: Gene therapy product candidate (SRP-9003) for the treatment of LGMD2E, utilizing AAVrh.74 vector to deliver a gene encoding beta-sarcoglycan protein, manufactured via partnerships with contract manufacturers and delivered by infusion.

products.name: Facioscapulohumeral Muscular Dystrophy (FSHD) siRNA Therapy
products.description: siRNA-based therapeutic candidate (SRP-1001) targeting DUX4 for FSHD, developed using Arrowhead’s targeted RNAi platform, manufactured in collaboration with Arrowhead and contract partners, and delivered systemically.

products.name: Myotonic Dystrophy Type 1 (DM1) siRNA Therapy
products.description: siRNA-based therapeutic candidate (SRP-1003) targeting DMPK for DM1, developed with Arrowhead’s RNAi platform, manufactured in partnership with Arrowhead and contract manufacturers, and delivered systemically.

products.name: Other Neuromuscular and Skeletal Disease Genetic Therapies
products.description: Pipeline of RNA-targeted, siRNA, and gene therapy candidates for rare neuromuscular and skeletal diseases (including SCA, IPF, Huntington's disease), developed through proprietary platforms and strategic collaborations, with manufacturing via contract partners.

products.name: LYMPHIR (denileukin diftitox-cdxl)
products.description: A recombinant DNA-derived fusion protein oncology therapeutic, administered via intravenous infusion, for the treatment of persistent or recurrent cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (CTCL). Manufactured using cGMP processes and distributed through third-party commercial partners.

products.name: Mino-Lok
products.description: A patented antibiotic lock solution containing minocycline, disodium edetate, and ethyl alcohol, used to treat and salvage infected central venous catheters in patients with catheter-related bloodstream infections. Delivered as a catheter lock therapy in clinical and hospital settings.

products.name: Halo-Lido
products.description: A topical prescription formulation combining halobetasol propionate (a corticosteroid) and lidocaine, intended to provide anti-inflammatory and anesthetic relief for patients suffering from hemorrhoids. Manufactured as a cream or ointment for direct application.

products.name: NoveCite Mesenchymal Stem Cell Therapy (NC-iMSC)
products.description: A next-generation, iPSC-derived mesenchymal stem cell therapy developed for the treatment of acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS). Manufactured using clonal, scalable cell culture techniques under cGMP conditions for clinical administration.

products.name: faidr App (Audio Streaming Platform)
products.description: A mobile application that enables consumers to stream AM/FM radio stations and podcasts with AI-driven features such as ad-free listening, content personalization, and on-demand controls. The app uses proprietary AI to identify and replace commercials in real time with music tracks, and is delivered digitally via iOS and Android app stores.

products.name: Discovr Radio Platform (Artist Promotion and Music Discovery)
products.description: A web-based SaaS platform for artists, managers, and labels to upload and manage music campaigns for guaranteed placement within live AM/FM radio streams delivered through the faidr app. The platform uses AI to insert new music into radio streams during commercial breaks and provides campaign management and analytics tools. Delivered as a subscription service to artists and labels.

products.name: Exclusive Content Offerings (faidrRadio, Music Casts, and Podcasts)
products.description: A suite of exclusive digital audio content, including proprietary music stations (faidrRadio), Music Casts, and podcasts, available through the faidr app. Content is delivered digitally and includes both exclusive and publicly available podcasts, as well as curated music programming.

products.name: Commercial Banking Services
products.description: Provides commercial, small business, agricultural, and real estate loans, as well as commercial leasing, treasury management, payment services, merchant services, and retirement planning to business clients. Delivered through physical banking centers and digital channels, requiring regulated financial infrastructure and in-person expertise.

products.name: Consumer Banking Services
products.description: Offers checking and savings accounts, certificates of deposit, health savings accounts, IRAs, consumer loans, credit cards, mortgages, home equity lines, and online/mobile banking to individuals. Delivered via branches, online, and ATMs, requiring regulated infrastructure and digital platforms.

products.name: Specialty Equipment and Vehicle Financing
products.description: Provides loans and leases for construction equipment, aircraft, auto and light truck fleets, and medium/heavy duty trucks to commercial clients nationwide. Delivered through specialized finance teams and subsidiaries, requiring financial capital and industry-specific expertise.

products.name: Renewable Energy Project Financing
products.description: Finances commercial solar projects, including construction and permanent loans and tax equity investments for community, commercial, industrial, utility, university, and municipal solar projects. Delivered through specialized lending teams, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Trust and Wealth Advisory Services
products.description: Offers trust, investment, agency, and custodial services for individuals, estates, corporations, not-for-profits, and employee benefit plans. Delivered by financial advisors and trust officers, requiring regulated fiduciary infrastructure and in-person expertise.

products.name: Insurance Brokerage Services
products.description: Provides property and casualty, individual and group health, and life insurance products to individuals and businesses through its insurance agency subsidiary. Delivered via insurance agents in dedicated offices and banking centers, requiring licensing and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Office Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of office space in owned office buildings located predominantly in Sun Belt metropolitan areas. This involves physical real estate assets, with leasing agreements that often include rent escalations and pass-throughs for cost increases. Properties are maintained, improved, and managed to attract and retain tenants.

products.name: Branded Promotional Products and Uniform Programs
products.description: Customized merchandising solutions including promotional products, branded uniforms, corporate awards, incentives, event promotions, and specialty packaging, manufactured in-house or through third parties and delivered to a wide range of industries.

products.name: Healthcare Apparel and Accessories
products.description: Manufactures and sells healthcare apparel such as scrubs, lab coats, patient gowns, protective apparel, and related accessories for hospitals, healthcare facilities, laundries, and professionals, produced in-house or via third-party manufacturers.

products.name: Outsourced Contact Center and Business Process Services
products.description: Provides outsourced, nearshore and onshore business process outsourcing, contact and call-center support services to North American customers, delivered through multilingual agents in multiple countries.

products.name: Allogeneic Cell and Gene Therapies for Oncology
products.description: Therapeutic products based on genetically modified allogeneic cells, such as dendritic cell vaccines, designed to promote immune responses for long-term remission in solid tumors (e.g., pancreatic, liver, triple negative breast, head & neck cancers). These therapies require advanced cell engineering, manufacturing, and regulatory approval for clinical use.

products.name: AI-Driven Multi-Omics Cancer Diagnostics and Liquid Biopsy Tests
products.description: Software and laboratory-based diagnostic products and test kits that use proprietary AI platforms to analyze multi-omics data (genomics, epigenomics, proteomics, etc.) from liquid biopsy samples for early cancer detection, recurrence monitoring, and patient stratification. Delivered via certified service labs and partnerships with third-party labs, these products combine digital analytics with physical sample processing.

products.name: AI Platform for Precision Diagnostics and Clinical Decision Support
products.description: Enterprise software platform providing AI-assisted diagnostics, multi-omic data analysis, biomarker discovery, and differential diagnosis for healthcare providers, research centers, and pharmaceutical companies. The platform integrates diverse data sources and delivers explainable, actionable insights for disease characterization, treatment selection, and prognosis, primarily as a digital solution.

products.name: Multi-Omics Sequencing and Data Analysis Services
products.description: Certified laboratory services for multi-omic sequencing (using platforms like Oxford Nanopore) and data analysis, offered to third parties such as research and academic institutes. These services include sample processing, sequencing, and advanced computational analysis, supporting both research and clinical applications.

products.name: AI-Enabled Drug Discovery and Biomarker Discovery Platform
products.description: AI-powered software and experimental platforms for pharmaceutical and biotech companies to accelerate drug discovery, target identification, and biomarker discovery. This includes multi-omics integration, predictive modeling, and experimental validation using proprietary machine learning pipelines and knowledge graphs.

products.name: High-Throughput Experimental Screening for Neurotherapeutics
products.description: Experimental screening services and platforms using zebrafish and murine models, coupled with AI-based behavioral and morphological profiling, to identify and validate neuroactive compounds and potential therapeutics. This combines in vivo experimentation with computational analysis for drug discovery.

products.name: Retail Brokerage Services
products.description: Commission-free trading of U.S.-listed stocks, ETFs, options, ADRs, and fractional shares via mobile and desktop platforms, with features such as recurring investments, instant withdrawals, margin investing, fully-paid securities lending, and 24-hour market access. Delivered digitally through proprietary technology and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Futures and Derivatives Trading
products.description: Trading of futures contracts, index options, event contracts (prediction markets), and short selling across multiple asset classes, enabled by regulated exchange access and proprietary trading platforms. Requires regulatory licenses and compliance with CFTC and other authorities.

products.name: Cryptocurrency Trading and Services
products.description: Trading, transfer, and staking of cryptocurrencies for retail and institutional customers in the U.S., EU, and globally, including perpetual futures, via proprietary and acquired platforms. Includes custody, fiat-to-crypto on-ramps, and developer APIs. Delivered digitally and subject to evolving regulation.

products.name: Self-Custody Web3 Wallet
products.description: A software application enabling customers in over 150 countries to store, manage, and transfer cryptocurrencies across multiple blockchain networks, with users maintaining their own private keys. Delivered as a standalone digital product.

products.name: Wealth Management and Investment Advisory
products.description: Expert-managed portfolios and tailored financial advice, including in-app performance tracking, tax management, and portfolio simulations, delivered via digital platforms and supported by RIA custodial and portfolio management capabilities for both retail and advisor-led clients.

products.name: Retirement Accounts
products.description: Commission-free traditional and Roth IRAs with features such as instant deposits, employer-like matching, and custom or self-directed portfolios, accessible via digital platforms and designed for both traditional employees and gig workers.

products.name: Credit Card Services
products.description: A no-annual-fee credit card for qualified subscribers, offering rewards redeemable for travel, shopping, or investment, managed via a dedicated mobile app and issued in partnership with a regulated bank.

products.name: Banking Services
products.description: High-yield checking and savings accounts, on-demand cash delivery, and 24/7 support, provided in partnership with a regulated bank and available exclusively to premium subscribers. Delivered digitally with FDIC insurance.

products.name: Premium Subscription (Robinhood Gold)
products.description: A paid subscription offering enhanced features such as higher interest rates, increased IRA match, larger instant deposits, lower trading fees, exclusive mortgage rates, professional research, and advanced market data. Delivered digitally to subscribers.

products.name: Stock Tokens and Tokenized Assets
products.description: Derivative contracts tracking U.S. stocks or ETPs, allowing eligible EU customers to gain exposure to U.S. equities without owning underlying shares, with 24/5 access and dividend mirroring. Delivered digitally and regulated in relevant jurisdictions.

products.name: Tax-Advantaged Investment Accounts (UK/EU)
products.description: Tax-efficient investment accounts such as stocks and shares ISAs in the UK and multi-currency wallets, enabling customers to invest without incurring tax on capital gains or investment income, delivered via dedicated digital platforms.

products.name: AI Investment Tools (Robinhood Cortex)
products.description: AI-powered tools providing real-time analysis, market insights, and portfolio digests to help customers navigate markets and identify opportunities, integrated into digital platforms.

products.name: Financial Education and Media Content
products.description: Free educational resources, in-app tutorials, newsfeeds, and original editorial content designed to improve financial literacy and market awareness, accessible to all users via web and app platforms.

products.name: Closed-End Venture Fund (Robinhood Ventures Fund I)
products.description: A listed closed-end fund providing retail investors with exposure to private companies, managed as a long-term investment vehicle and registered under the 1940 Act.

products.name: Digital Advertising Measurement and Analytics Solutions
products.description: A suite of software solutions that provide real-time, AI-powered measurement and analytics for digital advertising campaigns, including metrics for fraud detection, brand suitability, viewability, and geographic compliance. Delivered via cloud-based platforms and integrated with major ad buying and publishing systems, these solutions require advanced data infrastructure and proprietary algorithms.

products.name: Attention Measurement and Optimization Solutions
products.description: AI-driven tools that measure and optimize consumer attention and engagement with digital ads, providing actionable data for campaign performance improvement. These solutions analyze exposure and engagement metrics in real time and are delivered as cloud-based analytics services.

products.name: Custom Contextual Targeting Solutions
products.description: Software solutions that enable advertisers to match ads to relevant content based on advanced content analytics, maximizing user engagement and campaign performance without relying on third-party cookies. Delivered as a digital service integrated with programmatic ad platforms.

products.name: AI-Powered Campaign Optimization Solutions (Scibids AI and DV Authentic AdVantage)
products.description: AI-based optimization platforms that use impression-level, first-party, and measurement data to build algorithmic models for improving digital ad campaign outcomes, operational efficiency, and media performance. Delivered as integrated software solutions for advertisers and agencies.

products.name: Marketing Attribution and Cross-Channel Measurement Solutions (Rockerbox)
products.description: Cloud-based analytics tools that unify cross-channel conversion and spend data, applying advanced attribution models and incrementality testing to measure and optimize the impact of advertising on business outcomes. Delivered as a SaaS platform for brands and agencies.

products.name: Publisher Analytics and Yield Management Solutions (DV Publisher Suite)
products.description: A unified software suite for digital publishers and supply-side platforms to manage ad inventory, optimize video delivery, increase yield, and provide analytics on media quality, campaign delivery, and industry benchmarks. Delivered as a cloud-based platform integrated with publisher systems.

products.name: Masked Immuno-Oncology (I-O) Therapies
products.description: Biologically engineered immuno-oncology therapies that are masked to remain inactive until activated by tumor-specific proteases within the tumor microenvironment, aiming to provide potent anti-tumor effects with reduced systemic toxicity. These are produced using proprietary protein engineering and masking technology, and delivered as injectable biologic drugs.

products.name: Masked T Cell Engager Therapies
products.description: Engineered biologic molecules that redirect T cells to attack cancer cells by binding both tumor-associated antigens and T cell receptors, with masking domains that prevent activation until reaching the tumor microenvironment. These are manufactured as protein therapeutics and delivered via injection.

products.name: Masked Bispecific PD-1 / IL-2 Fusion Protein (XTX501)
products.description: A bispecific antibody fusion protein combining PD-1 targeting and masked IL-2, designed to selectively stimulate T cells in the tumor microenvironment. Manufactured as a biologic drug using recombinant protein technology and delivered by injection.

products.name: Masked IL-12 Therapy (Efarindodekin Alfa)
products.description: A masked interleukin-12 (IL-12) biologic designed to activate immune responses within tumors while minimizing systemic toxicity. Produced via recombinant protein manufacturing and administered as an injectable drug.

products.name: Masked Anti-CTLA-4 Antibody Therapy (Vilastobart)
products.description: A tumor-activated, Fc-enhanced, high-affinity anti-CTLA-4 monoclonal antibody designed to block CTLA-4 and deplete regulatory T cells upon activation in the tumor microenvironment. Manufactured as a recombinant monoclonal antibody and delivered by injection.

products.name: Local News and Information Publishing
products.description: Production and distribution of local news and information through daily and weekly newspapers, digital platforms, and mobile applications. Content is created by in-house journalists and delivered via print and digital channels to subscribers.

products.name: Digital Subscription Platforms
products.description: Digital-only subscription services providing access to local news and information via web and mobile platforms, requiring digital infrastructure and content management systems.

products.name: Print Subscription Services
products.description: Traditional print newspaper subscriptions delivered to customers' homes or businesses, requiring physical printing and distribution logistics.

products.name: Advertising and Marketing Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive suite of omni-channel advertising and marketing services, including digital, print, programmatic, video, social media campaigns, and branded content, delivered through owned platforms and AI-powered tools.

products.name: Commercial Printing Services
products.description: Printing services for external customers, leveraging physical printing infrastructure to produce materials beyond the company's own publications.

products.name: SaaS Content Management Solutions
products.description: Software-as-a-Service content management platform (BLOX Digital) offered to external clients, enabling digital content creation, management, and distribution.

products.name: Digital Modernization and Transformation Services
products.description: Comprehensive IT modernization services including cloud computing, application modernization, data center and network modernization, asset management, support desk operations, and digital workplace enablement, delivered through consulting, design, implementation, and ongoing support for government and commercial clients.

products.name: Mission Software Solutions
products.description: Development and delivery of software platforms and applications, often leveraging artificial intelligence, for defense, intelligence, homeland security, and healthcare missions, provided as customized or integrated solutions for secure and mission-critical operations.

products.name: Cyber Operations and Security Solutions
products.description: Full-spectrum cyber solutions including offensive, defensive, and physical cyber operations, cryptographic management, and cybersecurity services, delivered through consulting, managed services, and technology platforms to protect critical information and assets.

products.name: Intelligence Analysis, Mission Support, and Global Logistics Services
products.description: Provision of intelligence analysis, operational support, logistics operations, security, linguistics, biometrics, CBRNE (Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear, and Explosives), energetics, and training services, primarily for government and intelligence community clients, delivered through specialized human expertise and technology integration.

products.name: Managed Health Services
products.description: Operation of health clinics and deployment of health providers for care delivery, including medical disability and behavioral health examinations, behavioral health management, and non-medical counseling, delivered through a national network of clinics and providers, leveraging IT and mission enablement capabilities.

products.name: Transportation Solutions
products.description: Development, integration, and support of air traffic control systems and automation solutions for air navigation service providers, including the FAA, delivered as systems integration, software, and capability development services to ensure safe and efficient air travel.

products.name: Energy Infrastructure and Modernization Services
products.description: Engineering, design, consulting, and implementation services for power grid modernization, utility planning, energy management, vehicle electrification, and digital infrastructure transformation, delivered to utilities, industrial clients, and government agencies.

products.name: Global Security Detection Products and Services
products.description: Design, manufacture, and deployment of integrated security detection products such as people scanners, baggage scanners, explosive trace detectors, and mobile inspection systems for aviation, ports, borders, and critical infrastructure, delivered globally with digital management platforms.

products.name: Life Sciences Research & Development Services
products.description: Operation of research and development laboratories and provision of scientific services in genetics, genomics, proteomics, biomedical computing, biopharmaceutical development, nanotechnology, and clinical trials management, delivered to government and commercial biotech clients.

products.name: Maritime Systems and Solutions
products.description: Development, manufacturing, and integration of autonomous and unmanned maritime platforms, vessel control software, sensor systems, secure communications, and naval engineering services, delivered for surface and subsurface operations throughout a ship’s lifecycle.

products.name: Aerospace Systems and Payloads
products.description: Design, manufacturing, and integration of space-based electro-optic infrared systems, electronic warfare and signals intelligence payloads, hypersonic missile structures, and testing services for hypersonic vehicles, delivered to defense and intelligence customers.

products.name: Land Systems and Integrated Air and Missile Defense
products.description: Development and manufacturing of integrated air and missile defense systems, persistent surveillance radar systems, advanced sensors, and radio frequency seekers, including associated algorithms, delivered as hardware and R&D services for military and defense clients.

products.name: Airborne Systems and Solutions
products.description: Development, integration, and operation of airborne solutions for training, intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance missions, including aircraft integration, sensor and autonomous systems, and multi-domain operation enablers, delivered as services and systems for defense and security missions.

products.name: AI-Powered Real Estate Platform
products.description: A digital platform leveraging proprietary artificial intelligence (HomeGPT) to provide end-to-end real estate solutions, including property search, interactive advice, virtual tours, and transaction support, delivered via web and mobile applications.

products.name: Real Estate Brokerage Services
products.description: Traditional and AI-enhanced residential real estate brokerage services, including agent-assisted buying and selling of homes, supported by digital tools and data-driven insights.

products.name: Cash Offer Home Purchase Program
products.description: A fintech-enabled service where Linkhome purchases homes for cash on behalf of buyers, then sells the property to the customer after they secure financing, streamlining and strengthening purchase offers in competitive markets.

products.name: Flash Sell Home Selling Service
products.description: A service allowing homeowners to sell their property directly to Linkhome for a competitive cash offer, with expedited closing and reduced need for repairs, open houses, or agent fees, facilitated through digital channels and streamlined inspections.

products.name: Buy Before Sell Program
products.description: A service enabling clients to purchase a new home before selling their existing one, facilitated by Linkhome through partnerships with third-party financial institutions to provide or arrange bridge financing.

products.name: Mortgage Services
products.description: Provision and facilitation of mortgage financing solutions, including access to a range of down payment and monthly payment options, often in partnership with third-party lenders, integrated into the home buying process.

products.name: Property Rental Management
products.description: Management services for residential rental properties, including tenant management and property oversight, delivered through digital and agent-assisted processes.

products.name: Home Renovation Services
products.description: Renovation and improvement services for residential properties, offered as part of the integrated real estate solution, coordinated through Linkhome's platform and network.

products.name: Property Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive management of residential properties post-purchase, including maintenance and tenant services, provided through Linkhome's platform.

products.name: Home Insurance Services
products.description: Provision or facilitation of home insurance products as part of the real estate transaction process, often in partnership with third-party insurers.

products.name: Title and Escrow Services
products.description: Facilitation of title insurance and escrow services to support secure and efficient real estate transactions, typically through third-party providers integrated into Linkhome's platform.

products.name: Home Maintenance Services
products.description: Ongoing maintenance and repair services for homeowners, offered as an ancillary service through Linkhome's platform.

products.name: Cosmetic Ingredients
products.description: A line of specialty hydrogel formulations and other ingredients (including Lubrajel, B-122, Orchid Complex, and Lubrasil II SB) manufactured at the company's facility and sold to cosmetic and personal care product manufacturers globally via distributors. These products are used for sensory enhancement, lubrication, hydration, and texture in skin care and color cosmetic products, and include both conventional and natural/COSMOS-certified variants.

products.name: Medical Lubricants
products.description: Hydrogel-based lubricants (primarily under the Lubrajel brand) manufactured at the company's facility and sold directly to manufacturers of medical devices and products. Used for catheter, surgical instrument, condom, and oral care lubrication, including customized formulations for specific applications.

products.name: Pharmaceutical Products
products.description: FDA-approved prescription drugs, including Renacidin (for preventing and dissolving calcifications in urethral catheters) and Clorpactin (a chlorine-based topical antimicrobial), sold primarily to drug wholesalers for distribution to pharmacies, hospitals, and other healthcare providers. Renacidin is manufactured by a contract manufacturer.

products.name: Sexual Wellness Ingredients
products.description: A line of hydrogel formulations (including the new Natrajel line) designed for sensory enhancement, lubrication, and moisturization in sexual wellness applications such as condoms, personal lubricants, intimate wipes, and personal moisturizers. Manufactured at the company's facility and distributed through partners.

products.name: Oil and Natural Gas Production
products.description: Ownership of partial interests in producing oil and natural gas wells, generating revenue from the sale of crude oil, natural gas, condensate, and natural gas liquids. Production is achieved through non-operated working, royalty, mineral, and overriding royalty interests in wells operated by third parties across multiple U.S. states.

products.name: Oil and Gas Royalty Interests
products.description: Acquisition and ownership of royalty, overriding royalty, and mineral interests in oil and gas properties, entitling the company to a share of production revenues without operational responsibilities. These interests are acquired through direct purchases and investments in limited liability companies focused on royalty assets.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides loans to businesses for purposes such as plant and equipment, working capital, real estate renovation, and other business needs. These are delivered through in-person banking, loan centers, and digital channels, and require financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers loans secured by income-producing commercial properties, including construction loans. These require underwriting, regulatory oversight, and are delivered via branch and loan center networks.

products.name: Residential Mortgage and Construction Lending
products.description: Provides residential construction and mortgage loans to individuals, including home improvement loans. Delivered through branches, loan centers, and online applications, requiring regulatory compliance and underwriting.

products.name: Municipal Financing
products.description: Offers loans and deposit services to municipalities, including loans and excess deposits secured by FHLB letters of credit. Delivered through specialized banking teams and requires regulatory compliance.

products.name: Retail Depository Services
products.description: Provides personal and business deposit accounts, including checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit, IRAs, and Health Savings Accounts. Delivered via branches, ATMs, and digital channels, requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Digital and Mobile Banking Services
products.description: Offers online and mobile banking, including bill pay, account management, and remote deposit capture. Delivered digitally via web and mobile apps, requiring secure IT infrastructure.

products.name: Cash Management Services
products.description: Provides online cash management for businesses, including account reconciliation, ACH origination, wire transfers, positive pay, and night depository. Delivered through digital platforms and in-person support.

products.name: Merchant Services
products.description: Offers merchant credit card processing and immediate credit of sales drafts, supporting business customers with payment solutions. Delivered via digital and in-person channels.

products.name: ATM and Card Services
products.description: Provides ATM access, Debit MasterCard, and ATM cards for cash withdrawals and payments. Delivered through physical ATM network and card issuance systems.

products.name: Wealth Management and Trust Services
products.description: Offers wealth management and trust services to individuals and organizations, including investment management and fiduciary services. Delivered by specialized staff and digital tools, requiring regulatory oversight.

products.name: Other Ancillary Banking Services
products.description: Provides standby letters of credit, bank checks, money orders, and safe deposit boxes. Delivered through branch network and requires regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Passenger Air Transportation
products.description: Delta provides scheduled air transportation services for passengers, utilizing a fleet of aircraft and regulated airport infrastructure to deliver domestic and international flights.

products.name: Cargo Transportation Services
products.description: Delta offers air cargo transportation services, moving freight and goods via its aircraft network, leveraging airport cargo operations and ground support equipment.

products.name: Private Jet Services
products.description: Delta provides private jet charter services through its Delta Private Jets division, offering on-demand, personalized air travel using dedicated aircraft and specialized crews.

products.name: REQORSA Gene Therapy for Lung Cancer
products.description: A gene therapy product consisting of a TUSC2 gene-expressing plasmid encapsulated in non-viral lipid-based nanoparticles (ONCOPREX Delivery System), administered intravenously to deliver tumor suppressor genes to cancer cells. Developed for use alone or in combination with targeted therapies and immunotherapies for non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and small cell lung cancer (SCLC).

products.name: REQORSA Gene Therapy for Other Solid Tumors
products.description: A gene therapy platform using the ONCOPREX Delivery System to deliver tumor suppressor genes (such as TUSC2 and NPRL2) to cancer cells, with ongoing preclinical research for use in other solid tumors including ALK-positive NSCLC, mesothelioma, glioblastoma, and others. Delivered intravenously using non-viral lipid nanoparticles.

products.name: GPX-002 Gene Therapy for Diabetes
products.description: A gene therapy product for both Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes, using an adeno-associated virus (AAV) vector containing the Pdx1 and MafA genes, administered directly into the pancreatic duct (via endoscopy), designed to transform alpha cells into insulin-producing beta-like cells or rejuvenate exhausted beta cells. Currently in preclinical development.

products.name: Wind Towers and Repowering Adapters
products.description: Manufacture of large steel towers and repowering adapters for wind turbine manufacturers, produced at a dedicated facility with significant annual capacity. Involves heavy fabrication, welding, and assembly of large steel structures for the wind energy industry.

products.name: Gearing and Gearbox Products and Services
products.description: Production of custom loose gearing, gearboxes, and precision machined components for OEM and aftermarket customers in diverse industrial sectors. Includes design, manufacturing, heat treatment, and repair services for gears and gearboxes, leveraging advanced engineering and metallurgical expertise.

products.name: Industrial Component Kitting and Assembly Solutions
products.description: Provision of supply chain solutions, inventory management, kitting, and assembly services for industrial customers, primarily in the gas turbine and wind power generation markets. Involves sourcing, assembling, and packaging components such as instrumentation, controls, valve assemblies, and electrical devices.

products.name: Mobile Modular Pressure Reducing Systems (PRS)
products.description: Manufacture of proprietary mobile, modular pressure reducing systems for the compressed natural gas virtual pipeline market. These systems are fabricated and assembled to enable gas delivery in regions without established infrastructure.

products.name: Solar Power Equipment and Structures
products.description: Fabrication of solar inverter racks and solar powered shelters/charging stations for the solar power generation market. Involves metal fabrication and assembly of structural and electrical components for solar applications.

products.name: Customized Debt Financing Solutions
products.description: Provision of tailored debt financing to lower middle-market companies, primarily through first lien senior secured loans, unitranche loans, second lien debt, and subordinated debt. These are structured, negotiated, and managed by investment professionals and require significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Equity Investments in Portfolio Companies
products.description: Minority equity investments in common or preferred stock, membership/partnership interests, or warrants of portfolio companies, often made in conjunction with debt investments. These investments are structured for capital appreciation and may include rights such as puts or registration rights.

products.name: Managerial Assistance to Portfolio Companies
products.description: Provision of significant managerial assistance, including guidance and counsel concerning management, operations, or business objectives, to portfolio companies that request such services. This is delivered by investment professionals and may be reimbursed for costs incurred.
